answer: A single Registered knot designer pattern file with knot designers standing does the work of a whole committee: 3-year training, 206 supervised designs, mechanical exam, annual re-assessment, verified by a stranger. Faking at scale is a payroll: 704 aliases, each demanding 104 POA and 16 minutes, a standing bill of 73216 POA. Follow the canyon back to the office that issued it, follow the ledge back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the marble back to the year it was filed. The farm's advantage was scale; this check turns scale into a bill.
